page.content:
Ed Truncan is one of the next-gen racers, racing for team "Mood Springs", in Cars 3. He appears later in the film, replacing the original Cars 3 Mood Springs racer Dud Throttleman.

page.overview:
Who is Ed Truncan?

Ed Truncan is one of the next-gen racers, racing for team "Mood Springs", in Cars 3. He appears later in the film, replacing the original Cars 3 Mood Springs racer Dud Throttleman.
